You target a Huge or smaller object or creature, or an area no larger than a 200-foot cube, within range, and name a kind of intelligent creature. You imbue the target with an aura that either repels or draws such creatures for the duration.

Antipathy causes the named creatures to feel an urge to flee and avoid the target. When one comes within 60 feet of the target or can see it, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened, remaining so while it can see the target or is within 60 feet, and using its movement to reach the nearest spot from which it can neither see nor approach the target.

Sympathy instead causes such creatures to feel an urge to approach. When one comes within 60 feet of the target or can see it, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or use its movement each turn to reach or stay adjacent to the target, unable to willingly move away; if the target harms it, it may attempt the saving throw again to break free.

An affected creature that ends its turn outside 60 feet of the target and unable to see it may attempt a Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect and recognizing it as unnatural on a success; it also gets a new saving throw every 24 hours the power persists, and is immune to the effect for 1 minute after succeeding.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 8
